missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Мясо' is the neuter nominative subject of 'лежит'. 'В холодильнике' uses the prepositional to show location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Мясо' is the inanimate neuter accusative object of 'жарю', identical to the nominative. 'На сковороде' is prepositional of location.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Мяса' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express absence. 'В супе' is prepositional, and 'совсем' intensifies.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Мясу' is the dative governed by 'обрадовался', which takes a dative complement. 'Свежему' agrees in the neuter dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental complement. 'Мясом' is the instrumental required by 'недоволен'. 'Жёстким' agrees in the neuter instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В мясе' uses the prepositional after 'в' to locate the content. 'Жира' is genitive after the quantity word 'много'.
Strategic focus: Genitive of quantity. 'Мяса' takes the genitive after the measure word 'килограмм'. 'Мы купили' is the subject and verb in the past.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Мясо' is nominative as the predicate noun. 'Вкусное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, intensified by 'очень'.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Мяса' is the inanimate neuter accusative plural object of 'продают', here meaning kinds of meat. 'Разные' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Без мяса' uses the genitive after 'без' to express absence. 'Суп' is the nominative subject, and 'невкусный' agrees with it.
